1.

The present application under Section 438 of the CrPC seeks anticipatory bail in case Fir No.
596/2018, under Sections 420/406/468/471 of the Ipc, registered at P.S. Tilak Nagar.

2.  The case of the prosecution is that the present FIR was registered at the instance of one Chander Prakash, who alleged that one Toyota Fortuner car, bearing Registration No. DL-1CQ-1522 was sold by the present applicant to him for a sum of Rs. 15 lakhs and thereafter, the applicant took the said vehicle on rent.
It is the allegation of the complainant that subsequently, the said vehicle was transferred in the name of a third person.
The present applicant did not return the aforesaid vehicle to the complainant nor did he pay any rent.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the present applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, learned APP for the State, on instructions from the Investigating Officer, submits that the documents were sent to the FSL and it has come on record, that signatures of the applicant on the said documents with regard to the aforesaid vehicle provided by the complainant have matched with his specimen signatures.
It is further submitted that investigation in the present case is complete and chargesheet has been filed before the Court of competent jurisdiction.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.

The present FIR was registered on 13.11.2018, a learned single Judge of this Court, vide order dated 05.02.2019 had granted interim protection to the present applicant, subject to his joining the investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer.
Since then, the present applicant has joined the investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer.
Admittedly, the investigation in the present case stands complete and chargesheet has been filed before the Court of competent jurisdiction.
7. In totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, the present application is allowed.

In the event of arrest, the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.
50,000/- with two sureties of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial

i.
The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the learned Trial Court.
ii. The applicant shall intimate the learned Trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the learned Trial Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
iv. The applicant shall join investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer concerned.
v. The applicant will not try to influence the witnesses in any manner.
vi. The applicant shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer and intimate about any change.
8. The application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
